form.title: USN Candidate Screening
form.description: Four quick questions. Record your answers on video or audio — whatever you're comfortable with. There are no trick questions; we just want to get to know how you work.

questions.prompt: Walk me through your hospitality or event experience — what roles have you held, and what kinds of events?
You're mid-event, a guest is upset, and your captain isn't nearby. What do you do?
What's your reliability like? Give an example of how you handle being scheduled somewhere you committed to.
Are you comfortable on your feet for 5–6 hour shifts, and do you have black service attire?

webhook.note: Point this at POST {PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/webhooks/videoask and send the shared secret as the X-Webhook-Secret header (or ?secret= query param). The value must equal VIDEOASK_WEBHOOK_SECRET in your .env.
